subject.title: fix(cli): cap config patch file input

question: Should `openclaw config patch --file` adopt the existing 1 MiB stdin ceiling even though an existing oversized-file workflow will now fail instead of being read and parsed?
rationale: The code change is mechanically narrow, but it intentionally changes accepted CLI input for existing users; repository policy treats removed fallbacks and stricter validation as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Adopt one input ceiling
options.body: Confirm that 1 MiB is the supported limit for both `--stdin` and `--file`, then rebase and land this bounded-reader fix.

options.title: Preserve large file patches
options.body: Keep the current file-input behavior and pursue a different resource-control design that does not reject existing oversized files.

recommendation.title: Adopt one input ceiling
recommendation.body: Confirm that 1 MiB is the supported limit for both `--stdin` and `--file`, then rebase and land this bounded-reader fix.
